findings.body: At teardown the cleanup targets a non-existent IDP (yielding a 404/NotFoundException) and the 20 created IDPs are never removed, leaking test state that can break subsequent tests.
findings.failure_mode: Test cleanup fails and leaves persistent IDPs, undermining test isolation.
findings.impact: At teardown the cleanup targets a non-existent IDP (yielding a 404/NotFoundException) and the 20 created IDPs are never removed, leaking test state that can break subsequent tests.
findings.root_cause: Hard-coded literal alias "alias" instead of the per-iteration alias used to create the provider.
findings.suggested_fix: Register cleanup against the actual alias, e.g. capture i and use testRealm().identityProviders().get("idp-alias-" + i)::remove.
findings.title: Cleanup registered for non-existent IDP alias "alias"
findings.trigger: The loop creates IDPs with aliases "idp-alias-0".."idp-alias-19", but each cleanup is registered against the literal alias "alias", which is never created.
findings.verifier_reason: Patch line 381 shows `getCleanup().addCleanup(testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove)` inside a loop that creates IDPs with aliases "idp-alias-0" through "idp-alias-19" (line 374). The cleanup references literal "alias" which was never created, so cleanup will fail with 404 and leave 20 IDPs orphaned.

raw_findings.body: An extra delegate (DB) lookup is executed on every remove even though the cached CachedIdentityProvider already holds the model, adding an unnecessary query.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Redundant database access on the cached remove path.
raw_findings.impact: An extra delegate (DB) lookup is executed on every remove even though the cached CachedIdentityProvider already holds the model, adding an unnecessary query.
raw_findings.root_cause: The delegate lookup was hoisted to run unconditionally to feed registerIDPLoginInvalidation, duplicating the cached lookup.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Reuse the already-fetched cached model for login invalidation instead of always calling idpDelegate.getByAlias(alias), or only perform the delegate lookup when the cache does not contain the entry.
raw_findings.title: remove() performs an unconditional uncached getByAlias lookup
raw_findings.trigger: Any call to remove(alias) where the IDP is already present in the cache (isInvalid returns false).

finding.root_cause: The delegate lookup was hoisted to run unconditionally to feed registerIDPLoginInvalidation, duplicating the cached lookup.

finding.title: remove() performs an unconditional uncached getByAlias lookup
finding.trigger: Any call to remove(alias) where the IDP is already present in the cache (isInvalid returns false).
finding.verifier_reason: The claim that the delegate lookup is redundant is incorrect. The patch moves `idpDelegate.getByAlias(alias)` to line 100 to be called unconditionally because `storedIdp` is needed for `registerIDPLoginInvalidation(storedIdp)` at line 111, which runs regardless of cache state. The cached model from line 105-107 is only available when `!isInvalid(cacheKey)` and cache contains the entry, but login invalidation needs the model in all cases.
